## Design

### 2026-10-24 – Started work on schematics and board.

**5h**

Started work on schematics and board.

Ideas for components:

2 slider potentiometers,
2 to 3 rotary encoders

After importing the symbol libraries, I got to work with the schematic file.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/44714ab5c435d185db07b1563bf77b31a8a781613b0a40a207ebc1aed03a51d0.png)

After importing and assigning the footprints I got to work with the PCB layout. For the capacitive touch pads, I made a pad footprint to fit.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/c45a37c63584f14be395f6b1b0906b59f9961f79813e7c92eab93e81876a0210.png)

The initial board layout:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/4b0d80fb9a132e69f2baae5e5df46b380b580335fe9913b1cccb415d17ff4c87.png)

After reconsidering the arrangement of components, I adjusted the layout again.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/024296f9f4ecb85cc77804cc45d7fa6c84020d33891ab4482cbb81b5d99ab1a2.png)

Doing some work on wiring the board. The orientation of components may make wiring more difficult, so that would be taken into consideration.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/01d40e6a8147240b1b6bf339ef43cf7d7503a32498f3fb834b87fff70ca9da33.png)

Will wire up the other components later

### 2026-10-24 – Adjusted the components a few more times and routed everything together.

**3h**

Adjusted the components a few more times and routed everything together.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/1cb49442a84cb3d64484862d72505eb23a4ade2694bb6f40c73bcea9786af780.png)

It took quite a bit longer than expected considering I had to figure out the arrangements for the tracks, so for the sake of looking neat the wiring is quite crowded in certain spots.

Also ran the DRC a few times just to look for anything that I broke when I moved things.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/9af3606cd84ec1568c2cfc83f7ef042e809992d26202ec2fbfa24fa42267f722.png)

Redid some of the bottom tracks for SW1 just to space them out better.

After thinking a little more, I added circles on the edge cuts layer for screw mounting holes to the case.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/jFcqnyfCgFHMycfuvGRyaq1Je6KCKoY0/8e5991c8b15ae97e56aa08fc845e6859f5afa717a673bb09845f7beb7452ea95.png)
